title: Phased main ruleset with an audited relax switch
goal: scripts/github-enforce.sh becomes phased and reversible: phase 1 = pull requests required + no force-push + no deletion (blocks the direct-push failure, adds no way to get stuck); phase 2 adds the required checks (Workflow Compliance, Format Check, cargo deny, Compile Check). '--apply [--phase N]' creates/updates the ruleset, '--relax' sets it to disabled (a deliberate, GitHub-audited settings change instead of a bypass actor, since every agent pushes with the admin's own key), '--status' prints enforcement and rules. Tests drive the script through a fake gh.
